text: This presentation was originally presented at the June 15, 2026 Board meeting and is being brought back to the Board with a minor technical amendment to slide 8. The amendment corrects the donation and investment amount into George Weston Recital Hall, which was incorrectly stated in the original presentation; the correct amount is $2.275 million. Staff recommend that the Board receive this item for information. The presentation provides a Board-level overview of the capital program, delivery roadmap, and key planning milestones across TO Live's facility portfolio. It includes project updates for all TO Live facilities, including Meridian Hall, Meridian Arts Centre, and St. Lawrence Centre for the Arts.
The Board of Directors of TO Live received the item for information.
